# Belinda

## Overview

- **Age:** 14-15 years old  <sub>[v1 c19 P38](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0038), [v1 c19 P76](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c19 P38](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0038)</sub>
- **Origin:** Boston  <sub>[v1 c19 P76](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0076)</sub>
- **Role:** Hired servant to Miss Rosalind Penrose  <sub>[v1 c19 P38](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0038), [v1 c19 P76](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0076)</sub>
- **Titles:** Belinda the Fourth  <sub>[v1 c19 P38](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0038), [v1 c19 P76](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

Belinda is a short, round, freckled girl with a very wide mouth and long, fair hair braids fastened with oversized blue ribbon bows. On special occasions, she wears an overly starched white dress adorned with four large blue ribbons. She considers herself plain, possessing short, plump fingers and a broad, constant smile.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P34](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0034), [v1 c19 P38](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0038), [v1 c19 P70](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0070), [v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028)_

## Personality

Belinda is a cheerful, practical, and intensely loyal girl who speaks in an eager and direct manner. Despite her rustic appearance, she is a hardworking, devoted helper who is quick to smile and deeply attached to her mistress. Though she lacks an imaginative nature herself, she is tolerant and protective of those who possess one.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P38](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0038), [v1 c19 P44](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0044), [v1 c19 P88](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0088), [v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028)_

## Traits

- Hardworking and devoted  <sub>[v1 c19 P38](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0038), [v1 c19 P88](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0088)</sub>
- Practical-minded  <sub>[v1 c19 P44](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0044)</sub>
- Highly loyal  <sub>[v1 c19 P70](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0070), [v1 c19 P88](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0088)</sub>
- Accident-prone with chinaware  <sub>[v1 c19 P88](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0088), [v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028)</sub>

## Abilities

- Domestic housework and cooking  <sub>[v1 c19 P38](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0038), [v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028)</sub>
- Clittering and imitating others' mannerisms  <sub>[v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028)</sub>

## Goals

- Faithfully serve Miss Rosalind Penrose  <sub>[v1 c19 P70](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0070), [v1 c19 P88](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0088)</sub>
- Emulate Nell's graceful deportment  <sub>[v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028)</sub>

## History

Belinda came to live at Echo Cottage at the age of thirteen to assist Miss Rosalind Penrose with domestic chores, becoming the fourth in a succession of Bowman sisters to hold the position and accept the moniker 'Belinda.' During the visit of Nell and Isolde to Echo Cottage, she dutifully assisted her mistress with entertaining and managing the household, despite a propensity for breaking chinaware. When Miss Penrose's former suitor, Stephen Stanhope, returned to court her, Belinda eagerly supported the romance. Following Miss Penrose's wedding to Stephen Stanhope at Echo Cottage, Belinda prepared to relocate to Boston with the newlyweds to continue serving them.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P38](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0038), [v1 c19 P76](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0076), [v1 c19 P88](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0088), [v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028), [v1 c25 P31](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0031)_

## Background by volume

- Born as Leonora Bowman, the youngest daughter in the Bowman family  <sub>[v1 c19 P76](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0076)</sub>
- Hired at thirteen to live with Miss Rosalind Penrose in exchange for room, board, and clothes  <sub>[v1 c19 P76](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0076)</sub>
- Succeeded her older sisters as the fourth 'Belinda' in Miss Penrose's service  <sub>[v1 c19 P76](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0076)</sub>

## Quotes

> There is a whole lot of difference between saying 'Belinda' and saying 'Belinda the Fourth,' Miss Harcourt, ma'am.  <sub>[v1 c19 P76](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0076)</sub>

> Oh, Miss Harcourt, ma'am, what a world of trouble it saves to just let things be!  <sub>[v1 c19 P88](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0088)</sub>
